description: Compliance scores for REQUIRED vs GAP AGIT categories on the 4-format fulltest (n=62). The project does not define a literal field named 'compliance score'; closest documented notions are template section coverage (instruction_linter / n_required/n_gap) and metrics.py coverage/has_gap. Primary compliance here = template compliance: fraction of the canonical REQUIRED10 / GAP5 lists present as detected ## sections in the prediction (sections_from_markdown heading probes). Secondary = gold recall compliance: of gold categories in each bucket, fraction also present in pred. Also includes ROUGE/emb from metrics_required_vs_gap.json (parallel job) and legacy keyword coverage.

definition_used.primary: template_compliance = |pred ∩ bucket| / |bucket| (REQUIRED: /10, GAP: /5), macro-averaged over files
definition_used.secondary: gold_recall_compliance = |gold∩bucket ∩ pred| / |gold∩bucket|, macro over files with ≥1 gold cat in bucket
not_used_as_primary: metrics.py coverage/has_gap (keyword bags; has_gap is binary any-gap)
gold∩pred ROUGE (quality, not presence compliance) — included separately from metrics_required_vs_gap.json

REQUIRED.definition: mean(|gold∩REQUIRED ∩ pred| / |gold∩REQUIRED|) over files with ≥1 gold REQUIRED

GAP.definition: mean(|gold∩GAP ∩ pred| / |gold∩GAP|) over files with ≥1 gold GAP

REQUIRED.definition: mean(|gold∩REQUIRED ∩ pred| / |gold∩REQUIRED|) over files with ≥1 gold REQUIRED

GAP.definition: mean(|gold∩GAP ∩ pred| / |gold∩GAP|) over files with ≥1 gold GAP

zero_shot.note: legacy metrics.py: coverage=#/10 REQUIRED keyword buckets; has_gap=any GAP keyword (not per-category)

rag.note: legacy metrics.py: coverage=#/10 REQUIRED keyword buckets; has_gap=any GAP keyword (not per-category)
